driveLogger_toggle.onDown: if not driveLogger then extensions.load('driveLogger') end driveLogger.toggle()
driveLogger_toggle.title: driveLogger: start / stop recording
driveLogger_toggle.desc: Toggles the driveLogger telemetry recorder on the current vehicle

driveLogger_aiSmartFlee.onDown: if not driveLogger then extensions.load('driveLogger') end driveLogger.aiTest('smart')
driveLogger_aiSmartFlee.title: driveLogger: AI test - smart flee + log (this car)
driveLogger_aiSmartFlee.desc: Makes the current car a fleeing smartAI Moonhawk and logs it. Press again in that car to stop.

driveLogger_aiStockFlee.onDown: if not driveLogger then extensions.load('driveLogger') end driveLogger.aiTest('stock')
driveLogger_aiStockFlee.title: driveLogger: AI test - stock flee + log (this car)
driveLogger_aiStockFlee.desc: Makes the current car a fleeing stock AI and logs it, for comparison. Press again in that car to stop.

driveLogger_haltAll.onDown: for _, v in ipairs(getAllVehicles()) do v:queueLuaCommand('if driveLogger then driveLogger.halt() end') end ui_message('driveLogger: stopped all loggers and AI', 4, 'driveLogger')
driveLogger_haltAll.title: driveLogger: STOP ALL (every car: logger off, AI stops)
driveLogger_haltAll.desc: Stops logging on every vehicle and brings any AI-driven vehicle to a stop
